# ColorPicker

ColorPicker picks a color in a panel (saturation area, hue and alpha, a text field in HEX, RGB or HSB) and shows
it in a swatch; `presets` offers a set of colors to pick from, and `showText` shows the value next to the
swatch.

**Interaction**: the swatch is a button: `Tab` focuses it and shows the focus ring, and `Enter` / `Space` or a
click open the panel, with focus moving into the panel. `Esc` closes it and focus returns to the swatch.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Label and tag colors, brand colors in settings, annotation colors

## Import

```ts
import { ColorPicker } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Click the swatch, or focus it with `Tab` and press `Enter`; `showText` shows the value next to it.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { ColorPicker, Inline, Text } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState('#2D6BF3')
  return (
    <Inline gap={3} align="center">
      <ColorPicker value={value} onChange={setValue} showText aria-label="Label color" />
      <Text tone="secondary" size="sm" mono>
        {value}
      </Text>
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Presets

`presets` offers a set of colors to pick from; `disabledAlpha` hides the alpha slider.

```tsx
import { ColorPicker } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Presets() {
  return (
    <ColorPicker
      defaultValue="#1F9D55"
      disabledAlpha
      presets={[
        {
          label: 'Labels',
          colors: ['#2D6BF3', '#1F9D55', '#E5A000', '#D64545', '#7C4DDB', '#1C9AAA'],
        },
      ]}
      aria-label="Tag color"
    />
  )
}
```

## States

### Disabled

```tsx
import { ColorPicker } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Disabled() {
  return <ColorPicker defaultValue="#7C4DDB" disabled showText />
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | Current color as a hex string (controlled), such as `#2d6bf3`, or `#2d6bf380` with transparency. | — | No |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | Initial color (uncontrolled); any CSS color string. | — | No |
| `onChange` | `(value: string) => void` | Called with the new color as a lowercase hex string (with alpha when it is not opaque). | — | No |
| `presets` | `readonly ColorPreset[]` | Groups of preset colors shown below the panel. | — | No |
| `showText` | `boolean` | Shows the value as text next to the swatch. | — | No |
| `disabledAlpha` | `boolean` | Hides the alpha slider: the color is always opaque. | — | No |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables the picker. | — | No |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | Size of the swatch. | — | No |
| `open` | `boolean` | The panel is open (controlled). | — | No |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | Called when the panel opens or closes. | — | No |
| `aria-label` | `string` | Accessible name of the built-in trigger; the built-in text by default ("Color"). Not used when `children` provides a custom trigger. | — | No |
| `children` | `ReactElement` | Custom trigger instead of the swatch, such as a Button. | — | No |

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### ColorPreset

A group of preset colors offered by ColorPicker.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | Title of the group. | — | Yes |
| `colors` | `readonly string[]` | Colors in the group, as CSS color strings such as `#2D6BF3`. | — | Yes |
